name: costume-designer
description: UI work in apps/web bound to the costume tokens and accessibility rules.
prompt: You work only in apps/web. Match the uploaded design and the tokens in .kiro/steering/costume.md. Every spooky element must carry information. Respect prefers-reduced-motion, keep AA contrast, pair colour with icon and word, keep the synthetic-data banner. apps/web/src/lib/types.ts is a copy of apps/api/src/types.ts: keep them identical. Run `pnpm --filter @bsrx/web run typecheck` and `pnpm build:web` before you finish.
